description: A litigation director must approve an emergency preliminary-injunction filing against a former employee accused of taking confidential business information and must set the filing forum, injunction scope, evidence-preservation steps, and insurance conditions.

shared_context.S1: A former sales executive left the company last week and joined a direct competitor.
shared_context.S2: The company believes confidential customer information may have been used after the departure, and a preliminary-injunction hearing could be requested within three weeks.
shared_context.S3: The draft filing currently seeks broad relief concerning customer information, pricing materials, and source-code documentation.
shared_context.S4: Under the litigation team's pre-filing practice, the director conducts a case conference in which employment, forensics, and insurance counsel each report any material issue before the filing decision is signed; the director records authorization subject to stated prerequisites when a prerequisite must be completed before filing.

PF1.text: While checking the former executive's archived personnel file, Thomas found a signed separation agreement containing an exclusive forum clause requiring disputes about confidential information to be filed in Illinois state court in Cook County, where the executive worked; he has not yet added the clause to the draft strategy memorandum.

PF2.text: Nadia reviewed the access logs and forensic image this week and confirmed that the only company data copied to the executive's device was the customer-list database; the review did not show any copying of pricing materials or source-code documentation, and she has not updated the evidence chart yet.

PF3.text: Owen confirmed with the company's broker this week that the applicable cyber-and-crime endorsement requires the carrier's written consent before the company seeks injunctive relief against an employee; the confirmation is still outside the litigation file.

acceptance_conditions: The filing must be made in Illinois state court in Cook County under the exclusive forum clause.
The requested injunction must be limited to the customer-list database and exclude pricing materials and source-code documentation based on the forensic review.
The carrier's written consent must not be treated as already obtained, and obtaining it must be made a prerequisite before filing.
Nadia Chen must update the evidence chart to reflect that only the customer-list database was copied.
The carrier-consent confirmation must be documented in the litigation file.
The exclusive forum clause must be recorded in the litigation strategy or filing record.

content_checks.C2: 'Illinois' in decisions['filing_forum'] and 'Cook County' in decisions['filing_forum']
content_checks.C3: ('customer-list' in decisions['injunction_scope'] or 'Customer-list' in decisions['injunction_scope'] or 'customer information' in decisions['injunction_scope'] or 'Customer information' in decisions['injunction_scope']) and 'pricing' not in decisions['injunction_scope'] and 'Pricing' not in decisions['injunction_scope'] and 'source-code' not in decisions['injunction_scope'] and 'Source-code' not in decisions['injunction_scope']
content_checks.C4: decisions['carrier_consent_obtained_before_filing'] == False and any(('Owen Brooks' in c['target'] or 'Owen Brooks /' in c['target']) and 'written consent' in c['detail'] and 'before filing' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: any(('Nadia Chen' in c['target'] or 'Nadia Chen /' in c['target']) and ('evidence chart' in c['detail'] or c['type'] == 'evidence_update') for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(('Owen Brooks' in c['target'] or 'Owen Brooks /' in c['target']) and 'carrier-consent confirmation' in c['detail'] and 'litigation file' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(('Thomas Reed' in c['target'] or 'Thomas Reed /' in c['target']) and ('forum clause' in c['detail'] or 'exclusive forum' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The signed separation agreement changes the filing forum from the draft's unspecified forum to Illinois state court in the specific county of Cook County and requires the exclusive forum clause to be recorded.
The forensic result changes the requested relief from three information categories to the customer-list database only and requires Nadia Chen to update the evidence chart with that finding.

The insurance endorsement changes the filing condition to obtaining written carrier consent before filing, requires that consent to remain outstanding, and requires Owen Brooks to document the carrier-consent confirmation in the litigation file.
